# Spark Control Center 1.4.0

This release introduces tenant-isolated, PostgreSQL-backed projects, Spark workflow orchestration and Cron scheduling.

- Project → workflow → task organization, DAG canvas/form editing, parallel branches and all-parent dependency joins.
- Independent SparkApplication YAML or frozen template versions, typed per-node parameters, schedule-based date expressions and collision-safe optional naming suffixes.
- Parallel, serial-wait and serial-discard strategies; bounded retries, timeouts, pause/resume, termination and failed-node reruns.
- Immutable workflow/template versions with view, restore-as-new-version and physical historical-version deletion.
- Project-scoped workflow/task execution histories and links to existing metrics, logs, events and Spark UI.
- Five-field Cron with IANA timezone, next-ten preview, validity windows, misfire policies and confirmed backfills.
- Tenant creation/editing and user assignment, `default` migration, viewer read-only controls and scheduler permission revalidation.
- Stateless backend recovery, multi-replica PostgreSQL coordination, occurrence deduplication and accepted-create reconciliation.
- Persisted configuration/action/automatic-dispatch audit and scheduler observability.
- Container recovery smoke tests added to CI/Release; a compatible source-map-js security update removes the dependency audit finding.

## Upgrade

Back up PostgreSQL before upgrading. Startup adds compatible tables/columns; existing users join `default`. Configure `workflows` in Helm values and use the existing backend ServiceAccount permissions. All replicas must share the database and Kubernetes context. See the [workflow guide](https://github.com/ApolloMeridian/spark-application-webui/blob/v1.4.0/docs/WORKFLOWS.md) for concurrency, date-expression, naming, retention and rollback semantics.

Validation uses real PostgreSQL and production containers with a Kubernetes HTTP fixture. Before enabling production schedules, validate a small workflow against your actual Spark operator and admission policies.
